mapper.select:
SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.TOTAL_QTY, C.ISSUED_QTY, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, C.STATUS_CD, B.BIZ_NAME,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MC.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ALREADY_CLAIMED
0 AS ALREADY_CLAIMED
FROM TB_COUPON C LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_ID = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE C.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY CASE C.STATUS_CD WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'EXHAUSTED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, C.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT MC.MEMBER_COUPON_ID, MC.STATUS_CD AS MEMBER_COUPON_STATUS, MC.USED_DATE, MC.REG_DATE, C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_CODE, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_VALUE, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.USE_START_DATE, C.USE_END_DATE, B.BIZ_NAME FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC JOIN TB_COUPON C ON C.COUPON_ID = MC.COUPON_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_ID = C.BIZ_MEMBER_NO WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY CASE MC.STATUS_CD WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'USED' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, MC.REG_DATE DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER_COUPON MC JOIN TB_COUPON C ON C.COUPON_ID = MC.COUPON_ID WHERE MC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MC.STATUS_CD = 'UNUSED' AND C.USE_END_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER_COUPON ( MEMBER_COUPON_ID, MEMBER_NO, COUPON_ID, STATUS_CD, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_COUPON.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{couponId}, 'UNUSED', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COUPON SET ISSUED_QTY = ISSUED_QTY + 1, ISSUED_BUDGET = ISSUED_BUDGET + #{discountValue}, MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUPON_ID, COUPON_TYPE, DISCOUNT_VALUE, TOTAL_BUDGET, ISSUED_BUDGET, TOTAL_QTY, ISSUED_QTY, STATUS_CD, USE_START_DATE, USE_END_DATE FROM TB_COUPON WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
